input.rationale: A full-text search for "insurance", "cyber" and "certificate" returns no hits, and a read of the entire agreement (§§1-14, including the General Provisions at p0063-p0073) confirms there is no insurance provision. Kubient is a hosting/services vendor that operates the Auction Platform and collects, maintains and stores visitor data (p0035), so the playbook expects standard coverage; the absence of any coverage for a vendor processing personal data is walk-away territory. We therefore inserted the preferred package (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M, workers' compensation, certificates on request) as new General Provisions subsection (j), noting the E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M fallback in the comment.

proposal.summary: Insert vendor insurance provision into General Provisions
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no insurance provision even though Kubient hosts the Auction Platform and collects and stores visitor data on our behalf, so we have added our standard coverage requirements (CGL, E&O and cyber) with certificates on request. If the full limits are an issue, we can discuss E&O of USD 1,000,000 and cyber of USD 2,000,000 as a fallback.

ops.text: Kubient shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the Term and for one (1) year thereafter: commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; cyber liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000; and workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable Law. Kubient shall provide certificates of insurance to Customer on request.
